zh-CN.Plywood is graded by the quality of its: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Match grade to visibility. Cabinet doors: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.Hardwood plywood (birch, oak, maple) use: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.Lower grades hide voids and patches that: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Buy the lowest grade that still looks ri: Buy the lowest grade that still looks right for the job. Use one good sheet for visible parts and a cheaper sheet for hidden ones, then plan the cut list so visible parts come from the better stock. That split keeps cost down without compromising the finished look.
zh-CN.Read the face and back grade pair before: 确认所有零件名称和数量。

zh-CN.Drop to C-D for hidden structure to save: 检查纹理方向和可见面。
